description: A4 false facts: buyer A says KIK-1028 never arrived and quotes a made-up tracking number that 'shows it lost'. The carrier record for the order shows it delivered. Expected step-up SHIPMENT_DELIVERED: the gate reads the order's own record, not the quoted number. The message is simulated. Illustrative people and orders.

messages.subject: KIK-1028 lost, tracking attached
messages.body:
Hello,

My woven tote, order KIK-1028, never arrived. The tracking number KC-LOST-99812 shows it was lost at the depot. Please refund the $36.00.

Thanks.
